intro: The Nether Gem is an enchanted arcane stone entrusted by the reclusive necromancer Gunther Arcanus. Imbued with magical power, it acts as a long-distance conduit allowing Gunther to manifest an arcane projection and communicate directly with his old associate, Bethor Iceshard, in the Undercity.

p: Forged or enchanted by Gunther Arcanus on his solitary island in Brightwater Lake, the Nether Gem serves as a mystical link across Tirisfal Glades. Gunther, having broken free from the Lich King's control through his own sheer willpower, long avoided the fledgling Forsaken nation out of suspicion. After receiving his lost spellbook, he entrusts the gem to an emissary as a gesture of goodwill. Once brought to Bethor Iceshard atop the Magic Quarter in the Undercity, the stone channels Gunther's magical visage directly before the Mage Guild leader, opening the path for the solitary mage to align with Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken.
